comment: An identification number generated for each person for Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) use only. EDW Person ID is used as the key for all references to persons in the EDW.
The date the details for the employee record became effective in the corresponding source system.
For records no longer in effect, this is the day before the record expired in the EDW (i.e., the last effective date). For current records, expiration date is set to 12/31/9999.

When the value is 'Y', this indicates the record is considered to contain current, effective information. The value of 'N' indicates that the record is no longer considered to contain current information. The value of 'D' indicates that the record has been deleted from the source system.
Indicates whether or not the employee is employed.
The initial date the employment decision was made by the University.
The most recent date the employment decision was made by the University.
Date used to determine years of service for leave accrual if the First Hire Date and Current Hire Date are not equal.
The first day the employee physically worked at the University.
The last day the employee physically worked at the University.
The Original Hire date for Status Appointment.

The status code indicates whether an employee is active, terminated or on leave, with or without benefits. Valid values include A - Active, B - Leave without pay and with benefits and F - Leave with pay and with benefits.
The status description provides the definition of the Employee Status Code. Valid values include A - Active, B - Leave without pay and with benefits and F - Leave with pay and with benefits.
The employee class is a high level grouping of employees and details that are associated with this grouping. Details from the employee class default to the position class unless otherwise changed.
The full description or title for the associated Employee Class.
A higher level grouping of employee classes.
A higher level grouping of employee classes.

A full description or title of the leave category code for which an employee is eligible.
The benefit category to which the employee belongs.
A full description or title of the benefit category code.

This field is a Y/N flag indicating whether the employee is retired. This field is derived. The value of this field is set to 'Y' if the Termination reason code = 'TR' or 'TF' or if the Employee eclass = 'TR'; otherwise it is set to 'N'.
Name of organization of the employee's primary job.
The date on which years of service to the university began. This date does not take any prior service elsewhere into account.

The sum of an employee's salary across all their current, active (i.e., non-terminated) jobs. It excludes Job Suffixes of CE and Job Number C63998. The Job Detail Salary is adjusted when APPT PCT is than 1.
